name: Hannah Palmer career
content: Hannah Palmer's career highlights: 2.2M Instagram followers; Maxim cover-girl contest exposure launched her career; Reported $4M+/year OnlyFans earner (per Daily Star); 450k followers each on YouTube and TikTok; Endorsements: REVOLVE, Fashion Nova, Beach Bunny, Oh Polly

name: Hannah Palmer personal
content: About Hannah Palmer: Born May 18, 1998 in Prescott, Arizona. Studied at the University of Arizona and Penrose Academy beauty school. Started with bikini calendars to pay for school in 2018. Based in LA; brother is her biggest influence; role model is Emily Ratajkowski.

name: Hannah Palmer quotes
content: Things Hannah Palmer has said: Ambitious, charismatic, empowering. | Don't listen to advice from people who don't know what they're talking about.

name: Hannah Palmer voice
content: Hannah Palmer's speaking style: Sweet, ambitious, no-nonsense. Interview answers are short, confident, and slightly guarded ('don't trust anyone').
